name: Rhône Valley
keyfacts: The Rhône is generally divided into the Northern Rhône and the Southern Rhône, each with distinct vinicultural traditions.
In the Northern Rhône, Syrah is the only red grape permitted, and whites come from Marsanne, Roussanne and Viognier.
The northern Rhône has a continental climate with harsh winters and warm summers, and the mistral brings colder air from the Massif Central.
Large pebbles around the vine bases in the south absorb the sun's heat by day and keep the vines warm at night.

blurb.text: A wine region of France with Northern Rhône and Southern Rhône inside it, plus areas such as Cairanne, Vinsobres and Costières de Nîmes.
